prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity desktop mockup for the existing MI Drug Test Payload CMS v3.90 admin, 1536x1100 landscape, clean Geist-like typography, light neutral native admin shell with blue action buttons and restrained green/yellow/red status colors. Fictional data only. IMPORTANT: retain ONE conventional Payload admin sidebar, about 230px wide, plain white/light gray, a small MI Drug Test logo and collapse hamburger at top, four compact existing-style extension buttons in this exact order: "Collect Test", "Quick Book", "Test Tracker", "Collect Payment". Under those show the NATIVE collapsible navigation group "Collections" containing the plain text link "Clients", and the NATIVE collapsible group "Referrals" containing plain text links "Courts" and "Employers". Tiny native account/settings/logout controls at bottom. Do not draw Today, Dashboard, Collections, Results as redesigned app navigation links; no second sidebar, no blue-tinted app sidebar, no technical Admin group for this staff role. Native collection links are simple text links, not icon cards. Body within the Payload default layout, breadcrumb and compact phase row if collection. Equal page/section typography on every screen. Any selected client must show an actual clear fictional adult male photo headshot at least 64px, with name "Alex Morgan", "DOB Jan 14, 1990", "Client C1042", referral "Charlevoix Court", current test, and an Edit link. Use photo of friendly neutral adult man with short dark hair, light gray shirt, plain background, NOT initials. Below identity show a compact always-visible medications strip: "Active medication: Adderall • configured expectation: AMP" and "Review medications" link. The expectation is fictional application configuration, not a clinical assertion. Before a PDF is processed, show neutral "Result not available yet", never green negative. After processing, the compact result strip must explicitly label Detected / Expected / Unexpected rather than rely on colors alone. No oversized panels. No code or implementation text in the product UI. Small "Design concept" note in top-right.

Main page is the standard staff home/dashboard, breadcrumb Home, heading "Today's work". Show a small "Standard admin" role badge near heading. Two top quick actions "Collect a test" and "Book appointment". Schedule list with 3 appointment rows each with distinct small headshot, names Alex Morgan 10:30, Jamie Lee 11:00, Sam Rivera 11:30. Status chips Ready, Waiting, Collected. Lower compact "Follow-up" card: "2 tests awaiting confirmation", "1 report delivery needs attention" and link "Open Test Tracker". No selected-client medication/result strip on this dashboard. Give the native sidebar clear visual prominence so user can understand the permitted staff links. No metrics dashboards or charts.

Main body collection phase Details, breadcrumb Collect Test / Verify result. Selected client header + meds strip. Heading "Verify instant result". AMP chip green, THC chip red. A small "Review uploaded PDF" button next to filename alex-morgan-report.pdf.
